audit_document: # STAGE 2: EBR AND TERMINAL RESERVE FORMULATION & ANALYSIS

03_STAGE2_EBR_TERMINAL_FORMULATION: Absent from current MILP objective (zero reserve/terminal terms)
column3: Minimization of EBR shortfall energy + terminal reserve shortfall energy (Wh)
column4: min J2 = sum_{t=0}^{H-1} max(0 E_EBR_target(t) - E_reserve_avail(t)) + max(0 E_terminal_target - E(H))

03_STAGE2_EBR_TERMINAL_FORMULATION: Implicit 20% min_soc_pct physical bound (no policy target)
column3: Symbolic E_EBR_target(t) and E_terminal_target (numerical values governed separately)
column4: E_EBR_target(t) in Wh and E_terminal_target in Wh (symbolic)

03_STAGE2_EBR_TERMINAL_FORMULATION: E_reserve_avail absent; battery energy E(t) bounded by min_e_wh
column3: Available reserve energy above physical minimum: E(t) - E_min
column4: E_reserve_avail(t) = E(t) - E_min where E_min = C_bat * min_soc_pct / 100

03_STAGE2_EBR_TERMINAL_FORMULATION: Free terminal energy state E(H) >= E_min
column3: Terminal energy target E_terminal_target at horizon end t=H
column4: E(H) >= E_terminal_target (or shortfall penalized in J2)

03_STAGE2_EBR_TERMINAL_FORMULATION: N/A (neither term present in current code)
column3: EBR at t=H and terminal reserve at t=H are mathematically coupled via E(H)
column4: Terminal shortfall and t=H EBR shortfall overlap if E_terminal_target incorporates EBR buffer

column3: Linearized using non-negative slack variables s_EBR(t) >= 0 and s_term >= 0
column4: s_EBR(t) >= E_EBR_target(t) - E_reserve_avail(t); s_term >= E_terminal_target - E(H); min J2 = sum s_EBR(t) + s_term
